'''M-6''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] that assisted [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Theron Shan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The droid had a domed [[Bronzium/Legends|bronzium]] head and communicated in the beeps and whistles of [[Binary/Legends|droidspeak]].
